claim: Digital Retina is mandatory visual perception but no longer required to remain a semantically independent cognitive module; sensor/perceptual semantics dissolve into one FRANK runtime as far as technically feasible.
Current public Digital Retina API is stateless image-to-structured-result and uses multiple CPU vision kernels plus heuristic/narrative aggregation.
Historical hard-set evidence documents fixed-class, OOD, compositional, OCR and upstream-error cascade failures; high later phrase-coverage numbers require calibration/leakage caveats.
Evidence/Perceptual/World separation plus bounded recurrence is superior to simpler temporal baselines.
Hybrid anchor/change processing and selective GWT/active sensing reduce compute and token cost while preserving perception/action outcomes.
